request_notes: 网关为 gpt-image-2 的 OpenAI 兼容中转（Plinth 的 OPENAI_BASE_URL）；为压低费用每个付费端点只发一次，取 1024x1024、quality=low、n=1：Plinth 默认 2048x2048、quality=max，响应结构相同，只有 usage 的数值不同。
edits 的参考图在付费运行里用的是 `image[]` 分片名（Plinth 的真实写法，网关返回 200）；wirefixture 的键规则不接受方括号，样本把分片名写成 `image`，fake 两种写法都接受。

内容审核拒绝（400 moderation_blocked）与 402 没有在官方网关上触发，fake 沿用真实 400 信封并换成文档里的 code 与 message；quota-exceeded 429（error.quota 信封）与 forbidden 403（eca_access_denied）依据仓库内已记录的真实网关响应构造，service-unavailable 503 依据官方错误码指南构造（2026-11-08 核对）。

endpoints.note: JSON request with inline base64 pictures; 400 empty_string (missing prompt) and 401 text/plain are real samples. The picture is drawn at the requested size (an auto or omitted size is 1024x1024) in the requested output_format, and the response reports the drawn size, output_format and background (background=transparent answers an alpha PNG); the committed samples only ask for 1024x1024 png, so the size, the format and the transparent behaviors are constructed-from-docs. The documented parameter contract is enforced with constructed 400s that reuse the real envelope and OpenAI's error vocabulary: size (gpt-image-2: both edges divisible by 16, longest edge at most 3840, ratio at most 3:1, 655360 to 8294400 pixels), quality, output_format, background, moderation, n (1 to 10, integer_above_max_value / integer_below_min_value, never clamped), output_compression (0 to 100, only jpeg and webp), a transparent background with jpeg, and a prompt over 32000 characters; the real gateway's wording for these refusals is not recorded (free negative probes are planned). quality max is accepted although the official page limits xhigh and max to the 2.5 snapshots: the gateway answered 200 for both on 2.6 (2026-11-09), and only a paid real answer can settle it (matrix B2), so the fake does not refuse it. gif and svg output_format are documented but not modelled (Plinth never sends them), and WebP answers the fixed 1x1 fixture whatever the size. n is documented by the official Create image reference (1-10) and returns that many distinct inline candidates. A content-policy refusal (400 moderation_blocked) and the 402/500 faults are not observed: they reuse the real 400 envelope with the documented code or message. The quota-exceeded 429 (the gateway's error.quota body), forbidden 403 (the gateway's eca_access_denied) and service-unavailable 503 (documented service_unavailable_error/server_is_overloaded) are constructed-from-docs answers built from the recorded gateway refusals and the error-code guide (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/error-codes, checked 2026-11-08)

multipart request with the reference picture in the image part (Plinth sends image[], the committed sample says image because the sample key rule rejects brackets; the fake accepts both). model is optional on this route, per the official Create image edit reference (default gpt-image-2.6-sunburst, checked 2026-11-24); the same constructed-from-docs 403/429/503 faults and the same parameter contract as generations apply (the text fields are multipart strings, so n is parsed as an integer). An edit takes at most 16 pictures (array_above_max_length on image). A mask is a PNG with an alpha channel and the size of the first picture, otherwise 400 invalid_image on mask (constructed: the official edit reference gives no mask rules and the gateway's wording is not recorded). With a mask only the transparent pixels change and the answer keeps the picture's size, for every one of the n candidates and in the requested output_format (PNG keeps the other pixels exactly, JPEG is lossy). A missing prompt on this route answers the documented missing_required_parameter: the empty_string answer is recorded for generations only
